problem_statement:
The input guardrail rejects simple arithmetic questions.

Asking the agent "What is 2 + 2?" fails with "Content must be
mathematics-focused". The prompt has no maths keyword, and the
arithmetic regex only matches operators with no surrounding spaces
("2+2"), so "2 + 2" is not recognised as maths.

Arithmetic with spaces around the operator should be accepted. Non-maths
prompts must still be rejected.
patch:
diff --git a/guardrails.py b/guardrails.py
index 9edebd9..8417561 100644
--- a/guardrails.py
+++ b/guardrails.py
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ EDUCATIONAL_KEYWORDS = [
 ]
 
 MATH_PATTERNS = [
-    r"\d+[\+\-\*/]\d+",  # basic arithmetic
+    r"\d+\s*[\+\-\*/]\s*\d+",  # basic arithmetic, spaces allowed
     r"[a-z]\s*=\s*\d+",  # variable assignments
     r"\\[a-zA-Z]+\{.*?\}",  # LaTeX commands
     r"\b(solve|find|calculate|compute|determine)\b",  # action words
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_guardrails.py b/tests/test_guardrails.py
index 8daf9f0..e97c1ea 100644
--- a/tests/test_guardrails.py
+++ b/tests/test_guardrails.py
@@ -15,3 +15,8 @@ def test_latex_accepted():
 
 def test_non_math_rejected():
     assert not is_math_query("Tell me a story about dragons")
+
+
+def test_spaced_arithmetic_accepted():
+    assert is_math_query("What is 2 + 2?")
+    assert is_math_query("12 * 3")
